2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Tunnels works for Subarnarekha Valley Corporation completed 2015.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included hard rock encountered below the founding level
over part of the alignment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department
for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of diversion of a live utility main discovered
during excavation. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.

3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was acceptable with minor
rework at two locations, and the work was inspected in stages, with each stage recorded in the measurement
book. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were within the
limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, no deficiency of consequence was recorded at handover. Regarding site safety, a
safety audit was carried out mid-contract with no major non-conformity. The agency's conduct during the
contract is recorded as prompt and well documented.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2015-03-05. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting
authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the
balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by K.
Deshpande, Superintending Engineer.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
undersigned.
